capabilities: Manage tasks in a Kanban board
disambiguation: Not merely a task map visualization; it is a full project planning tool that utilizes a dependency graph.
extras: All data (tasks, dates, dependencies, costs) is read from and written back to plain Markdown files, ensuring data portability.
motivation: To provide a planning layer over existing tasks, focusing on dependencies rather than just dates.
problem: Existing task plugins are effective for capturing tasks but lack the planning tools necessary to identify critical paths or manage complex project dependencies.

relations.evidence: Project Planner began life as a fork of Tasks Map by Nico Klaassen, and it owes that project its foundation: the graph canvas, the dual inline/note task model, the Dataview integration and the filtering core all started there.

summary: Project Planner transforms existing Markdown tasks into a comprehensive project plan, featuring dependency graphs, Gantt charts, Kanban boards, and financial tracking.
